# Synex Creator Video Platform

> Synex connects video creators with monetization opportunities by streamlining video uploads, automated verification, and fast creator reward payouts.

## Overview
- Website: https://synex.app
- Description: Upload video content, pass automated quality verification, and earn up to $100 per approved video submission.

## Platform Capabilities
- Video Submission: Upload high-definition MP4, MOV, or WEBM videos (up to 500 MB).
- Quality Verification: Automated and staff moderation checking 1080p resolution and content compliance.
- Creator Payouts: Direct wallet credits for approved video submissions.

## Key Features & Requirements
- Minimum Resolution: 1080p (Full HD)
- Supported Formats: MP4, MOV, WEBM
- Reward Cap: Up to $100.00 USD per verified submission
- Moderation Statuses: Draft, In Review, Approved, Paid, Rejected

## System Resources & Links
- [Platform Home](https://synex.app): Landing page and creator overview
- [Sign In](https://synex.app/login): Creator authentication portal
- [Submissions Dashboard](https://synex.app/submission): Track submission timelines and earnings
- [AI Plugin Spec](https://synex.app/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): Machine-readable plugin manifest
- [AI Site Manifest](https://synex.app/ai.json): AI agent metadata file
